Our airmail comes in so handy!}} ==Initial Equipment== {|class="wikitable" !Icon !Item name !Amount !Notes |- ![[File:Red flare icon.png|link=RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Red)]] |[[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Red)]] |1 |Must be fired into the sky at the old sawmill. |} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in Raid]]''' !Notes |- ![[File:Red flare icon.png|link=RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Red)]] |[[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Red)]] |1 |Required !N/A |Must be fired into the sky at the old sawmill. |- ! colspan="6" |OR |- ![[File:SP-81 Icon.png|link=ZiD SP-81 26x75 signal pistol]] |[[ZiD SP-81 26x75 signal pistol]] |1 |Required !N/A |Used to fire the flare cartridge. |- ![[File:26x75 flare cartridge (Red) icon.png|link=26x75mm flare cartridge (Red)]] |[[26x75mm flare cartridge (Red)]] |1 |Required !N/A |Must be fired into the sky at the old sawmill. |} In this quest you have to shoot a red flare into the sky while being in the center of the '''old''' sawmill in the east of [[Woods]]. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the [[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Red)|handheld RSP-30 red flare]] provided by Mechanic via in-game mail or a [[26x75mm flare cartridge (Red)|26x75mm red flare cartridge]] which can be bought at [[Ref]] LL3, and is fired from a [[ZiD SP-81 26x75 signal pistol|signal pistol]]. If you use the [[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Red)|handheld RSP-30 red flare]], make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you.
